sqld: 0.24.32 (pinned, SHA-256 verified), per-db process via sqlitend API

sweep.note: write-heavy 30/70 mix, 35s per level, one sqld DB seeded 100k rows
sweep.finding: aggregate throughput is flat ~2.2k/s at conc 1-4 on one core, declines past 8, thrashes >=16; p95 climbs with queueing

million.note: read-heavy 80/20 mix, fresh DB seeded 100k, conc=4, fixed 1,000,000 ops

wedgeFinding.observed: a sustained write-heavy run left the benchmark sqld process busy-spinning at 100% CPU with zero clients attached (load ~56 on 1 core). Killed the process; read-heavy run stayed healthy.
wedgeFinding.mitigation: batch writes, connection pooling, monitor per-sqld CPU
